text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. You're not one for working
these
contraptions either, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's the thought that counts. I appreciate
you
trying your best for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Besides, these games wouldn't be much
fun
without some challenge.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And we can always try again sometime.
It's not
like the game's going anywhere.
The important
thing is not to give up.
